name: audit-management-app-frontend
description: Vistar Audit — Flutter web. The `build` script lets Cloudflare Pages (which defaults to `npm run build`) compile the Flutter web bundle by cloning the Flutter SDK on first build, caching it for subsequent builds, then producing build/web. Set the Pages output directory to `build/web`.

scripts.build: if [ ! -d "flutter" ]; then git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git --depth 1 --branch stable flutter; fi && export PATH="$PATH:$PWD/flutter/bin" && flutter config --enable-web && flutter pub get && flutter build web --release --base-href /
